items.title: Meta launches Muse Voice: real-time video chat with an animated AI avatar (US)
items.summary: Meta made Muse Voice available to all US users, powered by new Muse Realtime Avatar and Muse Realtime Voice models. The avatar ("Jolly") changes expression to match the conversation's tone; it runs on mobile, web and Mac, with glasses and a Muse Charm device to follow.
items.whyItMatters: A big-tech real-time expressive avatar is a direct preview of the 'in-between' voice+video tutor experience Romain/Anna could grow into, and raises user expectations for face-to-face practice.

items.title: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Small (594B MoE, 17B active)
items.summary: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Small, a mixture-of-experts model with image input and variable effort settings, available now on Tinker with closed weights. Apache 2.0 weights are promised after safety testing; it does not support audio.
items.whyItMatters: No audio support means no direct use in the voice loop yet, but open weights later could give a cheap, tunable text brain behind a tutor.

items.title: Claude adds Personal Finance beta: link bank accounts via Plaid
items.summary: Anthropic launched a read-only Personal Finance tool letting US Pro, Max and Ultra users connect bank and card accounts and ask questions about spending.
items.whyItMatters: Shows Claude moving into personalized, data-connected assistants — a pattern relevant to tutors that use a learner's own history to personalize lessons.
